_comment: Committed host paths for the Vast L40S box (plan v3, owner 2026-09-16: the fourth hardware point (864 GB/s GDDR6)). Values are FILESYSTEM LOCATIONS, never design (D-609). The sm_89 helper .so lives on the root filesystem (/dev/shm is noexec). The device tile artifact binary_cohort_configs/NVIDIA_L40S.json and the Triton MoE configs are the A100's, CARRIED UNCHANGED for cross-device consistency (same posture as the H100 row); the regime-switch band is the roofline rule's output for the device's published peaks (device_roofline.json), asserted at boot and by the execution-difference gate.
